name: MenuMsg
meaning: u8 first argument of a MenuHandler void(u8 msg, MenuPage *self), from the dispatch sites in Menu_Update, Menu_Init, Menu_SetCapture, Menu_NotifyPageChange and Menu_Close

name: MENU_MSG_DRAW
meaning: draw your text (sent every frame to each visible handler node)

name: MENU_MSG_LEFT
meaning: LEFT (0xFF7F, auto-repeat) on a kind-1 item

name: MENU_MSG_RIGHT
meaning: RIGHT (0xFFDF, auto-repeat) on a kind-1 item

name: MENU_MSG_CONFIRM
meaning: CROSS: kind 1 (blocked while g_letterboxState == 1), or kind 0 just before the page is entered

name: MENU_MSG_FOCUS
meaning: became the cursor node, or became the open page

name: MENU_MSG_UNFOCUS
meaning: stopped being the cursor node, or the page was left

name: MENU_MSG_DRAW_SELECTED
meaning: sent after MENU_MSG_DRAW to the cursor node only (e.g. builds the footer)

name: MENU_MSG_PREDRAW
meaning: sent to each visible handler node before colour selection (handlers set their disabled bit here)

name: MENU_MSG_INIT
meaning: Menu_Init broadcast to all handler nodes

name: MENU_MSG_CAPTURE_TICK
meaning: every frame while g_menuCapture != 0 (to the cursor node)

name: MENU_MSG_CAPTURE_RELEASE
meaning: capture dropped to 0 (Menu_SetCapture with notify, Menu_Update, Menu_Close); can arrive twice

name: MENU_MSG_VALUE_CHANGED
meaning: after LEFT/RIGHT on a kind-1 item
